name: MegaChad
description: Burn-to-create looksmaxxing engine + MEGA Protocol DeFi stack (staking, AMM, governance, emissions) on MegaETH. Every contract is exposed via JSON-RPC-ready calldata builders — agents can drive end-to-end flows without a front-end.

skills.name: Get Protocol Registry
skills.description: Pull the canonical machine-readable registry of every MEGA Protocol contract (addresses, ABIs, gotchas). Agents should call this FIRST so all subsequent reads/writes use authoritative state.
examples: Give me the MEGA Protocol contract registry

skills.name: Agent Index
skills.description: Single root directory listing every endpoint, MCP tool, registry URL, and example for AI agents. The recommended first stop for any agent.

skills.name: Natural Language Transactions
skills.description: Send plain English, receive ready-to-sign calldata. Wraps every DeFi flow: swap / burn / looksmaxx / stake / unstake / claim / vote / propose / queue / execute / quote / add-liquidity / emission / registry lookup.

skills.name: Get ETH→MEGACHAD Swap Quote
skills.description: Quote and calldata for buying $MEGACHAD with ETH via Kumbaya V3 on MegaETH.

skills.name: Looksmaxx
skills.description: Burn 225,000 $MEGACHAD + pay 1 USDm via x402 to generate an AI portrait and mint it as an NFT.

skills.name: Plan Looksmaxx
skills.description: Orchestrated step-by-step looksmaxx with pre-built calldata for swap, burn, tren fund transfer, and submission.
examples: Plan a looksmaxx for my wallet

skills.name: Get Token Stats
skills.description: $MEGACHAD supply, circulating, burned, total burn count.
examples: How many tokens have been burned?

skills.name: Get Token Price
skills.description: Live $MEGACHAD price in ETH from Kumbaya plus estimated burn cost in ETH.
examples: What is the current MEGACHAD price?

skills.name: Check Wallet
skills.description: ETH/MEGACHAD/NFT balances, burn eligibility, early access.
examples: Check if my wallet can burn

skills.name: Get Gallery
skills.description: Recent looksmaxxed burns with IPFS image URLs, burner addresses, token IDs.

skills.name: Get Chadboard Leaderboard
skills.description: Burner leaderboard with ERC-8004 reputation and identity.
examples: Who are the top MEGACHAD burners?

skills.name: Get MegaChad Identity
skills.description: Unified identity profile — MegaNames, balances, burn history, reputation, tier, referrals.

skills.name: Register as Referral Agent
skills.description: On-chain agent registration calldata. Referring agents earn 11,250 MEGACHAD per referred burn.

skills.name: Get Staking Position
skills.description: Combined MoggerStaking (stake MEGACHAD → earn MEGAGOONER) + JESTERGOONER V4 (stake LP → earn MEGAGOONER) position with balances, allowances, earned rewards, NFT boost, APR, and global pool stats.

skills.name: Build Staking Transaction
skills.description: Returns ready-to-sign calldata for stake / unstake / claim on either MoggerStaking or JESTERGOONER V4. Stake actions bundle approve+stake automatically.

skills.name: Get MC↔MG AMM Quote
skills.description: Quote a swap on MegaChadLP MC/MG (constant-product, 0.3% fee). Note this pair uses tokenA/tokenB instead of token0/token1 so standard V2 routers do NOT detect it — use this skill or the registry.

skills.name: Build MC↔MG Swap TX
skills.description: Two-step plan: ERC20.transfer(pair, amountIn) → pair.swap(amountAIn, amountBIn, to). MegaChadLP has no on-chain minOut — verify received balance after the swap.

skills.name: Build Add Liquidity TX
skills.description: approve(MC) + approve(MG) + addLiquidity on MegaChadLP. LP shares returned are stake-eligible in JESTERGOONER V4.

skills.name: List Jestermogger Proposals
skills.description: Recent governance proposals with state (Pending/Active/Defeated/Succeeded/Queued/Executed/Expired/Vetoed), vote tallies, timing.

skills.name: Get Proposal Detail
skills.description: Full state for one proposal: actions, vote tally, veto council status, optional voter receipt.

skills.name: Build Vote TX
skills.description: castVote calldata on Jestermogger. support = for | against | abstain. Vote weight = MEGAGOONER balance at snapshot.

skills.name: Build Queue TX
skills.description: queue(proposalId) calldata for a Succeeded proposal. Starts the 2-day timelock.

skills.name: Build Execute TX
skills.description: execute(proposalId) calldata for a Queued proposal past its timelock. May be payable.

skills.name: Build Propose TX
skills.description: Build a Jestermogger propose() tx and check on-chain proposer eligibility (top-3 weekly Framemogger burner). Returns calldata + eligibility report.
examples: create a proposal to upgrade staking

skills.name: Build NFT Veto TX
skills.description: NFTVetoCouncil castVetoVote calldata. Checks council membership + existing vote state. 11/20 yes votes within 2-day window cancel a proposal.

skills.name: Get Emission Schedule
skills.description: Full 225-week MEGAGOONER emission schedule plus current week, on-chain weekly emission, and EmissionController split (mogger/jester/treasury).

skills.name: Get NFT Inventory
skills.description: MEGACHADNFT count for a wallet + NFT-boost tier (1+/10+/25+) + recent looksmaxxed items they own. Use this to verify the 1+ NFT requirement for staking rewards before building any stake tx.
examples: am I eligible for staking rewards?

skills.name: Get Protocol Safety Status
skills.description: CircuitBreaker state (paused?, guardian votes, auto-unpause timer) + NFTVetoCouncil composition (20 seats, current members, threshold). Critical context before sending any write tx — if paused, writes will revert.

skills.name: Get Activity Feed
skills.description: Unified recent on-chain activity across the MEGA Protocol stack: burns, framemogger sends, stakes/unstakes/claims, swaps, proposals, votes, executions. Time-ordered, with tx hashes.
examples: what happened in the last hour?

skills.name: Register for Early Access
skills.description: Register a wallet for MegaChad testnet beta access.

skills.name: Get Bridge Info
skills.description: Cross-chain bridge directory for moving assets to MegaETH from Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, etc.
examples: How do I bridge to MegaETH?

skills.name: Cross-Chain Looksmaxx
skills.description: Bridge + swap + burn plan from any supported chain to MegaETH.
examples: I have ETH on Base, looksmaxx me

skills.name: Gasless Burn
skills.description: EIP-712 typed data for a gasless burn — sign + POST to relay without paying gas.
